command_site_revisions.what: the site no longer resolves its own frozen round (status:'active', sort -created_date, limit 1). It consumes loadRoundContext and refuses BEFORE any write when the contract reports conflict 'multiple_active_rounds'; the round's ballots are read from the same context (ctx.ballots) instead of a second independent query.
command_site_revisions.why: with two active rounds the site bound a ballot to whichever round the sort put first, while issuance and the governed read REFUSE that same state — so a ballot could be recorded against an electorate no package may be issued from (silent orphan vote + false 'has voted' state). See D-039 / reference R-17.

command_site_revisions.coverage_gap: no suite exercises the CastVote HANDLER: the round contract's own cases pass (incl. two active rounds => no round chosen), but the site behaviour is verified by source + build + module suites only.

grant_narrowing.defect: the narrowing branch required the capability to be absent from the role as well, a state the preceding branch had already returned on, so a populated permitted_actions list narrowed nothing
grant_narrowing.rule_now: a role-held right outside a NONEMPTY permitted_actions list is refused with code not_in_grant; explicit denial still wins; the list can only restrict, never extend

concurrency.changed_this_round: CastVote's claim key is now (decision, round, seat) instead of (decision, person)
concurrency.abandoned_claims: excluded from winner selection, so a released claim no longer blocks a later legitimate attempt
concurrency.unmet_invariant: the store exposes NO unique constraint and NO transactional rollback: two claim ROWS may exist. Only the material effect is exclusive. A simultaneous pair has NOT been measured (no concurrent-request environment in this build environment).
concurrency.open_resolution: a stuck 'claimed' row still blocks its key and needs releaseTransition (governed maintenance) or a stale-claim policy that is not yet defined
